description: This file defines a React component named PasscodeLock that manages passcode locking functionality, including setting, changing, removing passcodes, and configuring autolock intervals for a web application. It interacts with application state, handles user input, and displays UI elements related to security settings.

methods.name: handleAddPassCode
methods.description: Sets state to show the passcode form and focuses the input when user opts to add a passcode.

methods.name: changePasscodePressed
methods.description: Triggers the process to add a new passcode.

methods.name: reloadDesktopAutoLockInterval
methods.description: Fetches and updates the current auto-lock interval setting for desktop.

methods.name: refreshEncryptionStatus
methods.description: Updates the encryption enabled status and related UI based on current account and passcode status.

methods.name: selectDesktopAutoLockInterval
methods.description: Changes the desktop auto-lock interval after user confirmation.

methods.name: setMobilePasscodeTiming
methods.description: Sets the mobile passcode autolock timing option.

methods.name: removePasscodePressed
methods.description: Removes the existing passcode after user confirmation.

methods.name: handlePasscodeChange
methods.description: Updates passcode state based on user input.

methods.name: handleConfirmPasscodeChange
methods.description: Updates passcode confirmation state based on user input.

methods.name: submitPasscodeForm
methods.description: Validates and submits the passcode form, adding or changing passcode as necessary.

methods.name: cancelPasscodeForm
methods.description: Cancels the passcode input form without saving.
